utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Could you locate on the photograph where could be the mortar which hit the facade? And that picture is on figure 3 -- 33 in your report.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's one of these two buildings.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: How far would that mortar be from one of these two buildings that left the traces on that building?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Whichever one it is, it couldn't be more than 10 to 15 metres away from that facade, in view of the appearance of the traces.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Shall I put number 4?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Please put number 4.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: You are not recorded. You tendered it?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The marked picture of document P3 receives Exhibit Number D1271, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I didn't say I tendered it. I asked you if you tendered it. I'm not tendering anything.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Could we now look at figure 37 from your report, 1D05497.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Before we do so, you marked a minute ago the two buildings on which the impact would have taken place. I saw on the picture that there are five similar buildings there. What made you choose the two you marked? It seems that there's row of five apartment buildings.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, certainly, that's an understandable question. I was there on site, and in my memory, it could be one of these two buildings. I'm not sure which one is number 102.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Did you see the impact still there at that moment?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: What then -- it's mainly on the basis of -- in one of these two buildings number 102 is there - is that what you're telling us - and that made you believe that it's one of those two buildings?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, number 102 is on the building, and this information is in the CSB report.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Please proceed. On one of the buildings then, I take it, one of the two buildings. Please proceed, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. So if we have 1D05497 on our screens. We need page 103 in English version and 94 in B/C/S.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We don't have much time. I will not dwell op this much. You have covered in your report this shell. It is stated about this shell that the projectile landed in a -- in the garden of a residential building in Safeta Hadzica Street number 70 creating a crater 200 by 80 by 30 centimetres and that it was produced in Nazi Germany. First of all, is it possible for this shell to create a crater like that without exploding and would it be possible for such a shell to make that crater even if it had exploded?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to the CSB, they describe it as you said. First of all, it's not possible for that shell to make a crater of that size because it just can't if it didn't explode. It could create a furrow possibly, but if it had created a crater 30 centimetres deep it would just continue getting buried into the ground and it certainly couldn't create a crater of that length that was stated in the report.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honour, we have multiple impacts on this occasion. It's not clear to me what specific crater we're associating with this shell.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Lukic, it might assist already to clarify this now; otherwise, Mr. Weber will deal with the matter in cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I think there is only one shell mentioned in this report produced allegedly in Germany.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I think it is more about the crater than about the shell. If you can clarify, please do; if not, then Mr. Weber will be doing his task --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I will find you in the break where it is mentioned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I have cut out from that report but I don't have the number.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Take your time during the break.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On this photograph, the one we're just looking at --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we enlarge just the English version and have only the photograph on the screen?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Let me ask you, Ms. Subotic, in your opinion, was this shell fired?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely not. You can see it by the traces on the shell itself. Alongside -- along the projectile between the centre and the leading rings, they don't exist on any projectiles because both the centre ring and the guiding rings are larger in diameter.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Would you mark the guiding and the centring ring and mark whatever you're going to mark with numbers 1 and 2.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: What kind of ring is that, the centring ring?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And what is number 2, the guiding ring? Just a moment. This space between the centre ring and the guiding rings, what is it like compared to the rings?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It has corroded and it bears some lines that are not the kind of lines that could be seen if it had been fired, and if it had been fired, there would be no corrosion because -- because the -- the -- it would be cut into the grooves during firing.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And this part of the hull between the rings, what is it like?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is smaller compared to the diameter of the rings?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Let us now move to G-14. In English it's --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honours, just for the record, it was completely unclear to me some of the comparison that was going on, comparing whatever is in this to other items, but I leave that to counsel as to whether or not he wants to --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, if it's unclear to you, you can seek clarification in cross-examination, but Mr. Lukic is now aware of it. Could I ask one very short question. The top of what we see next to number 7, at the top of this projectile, is that how a projectile looks when it's intact and still to be fired, or could you comment on what we see at the top of this -- of this ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Towards the top, it is obvious that there is no fuse.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Do you have any explanation as how a fuse is -- has loosened itself from the body of a projectile?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have no idea when it fell apart and off, but it is quite clear that the projectile has not been fired from a tube. All we see is that there is no fuse. It could have gone missing in any way we can think of now. And, first of all, we don't know how this projectile found its way here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Do you tender this photograph?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, I'm tendering this into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Photograph of a projectile marked by the witness receives, Madam Registrar?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: D1272, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Admitted into evidence. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And it's a break time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: It's break time. Again and again, I make the mistake that I invite you to proceed when I should invite you not to proceed. Witness, we'd like to see you back in 20 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We take a break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Tieger, do we have to -- need to be in private session?

utterances.speaker: MR. TIEGER
utterances.text: No, Mr. President we do not. It is possible an inquiry by the Court may trigger that, but I don't believe so. This concerns the Court's earlier request for an expedited response by the Prosecution to the videolink request for Mr. Del Pinto. The motion appears to be analogous, at least in broad terms, to a circumstance that is not cited by the Defence in its motion, and that was the motion for videolink for RM088, for whom videolink was indeed granted. So in light of that and in view of the stage of the case and all of the circumstances surrounding this matter, we do not oppose the motion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you for that response. The Chamber will decide in due course. Could the witness be escorted in the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic, you may proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Ms. Subotic --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, preparing for the rest of my testimony today, I noticed I made a -- had an oversight in my presentation today. I said that for the FAB 100 air bomb a possible dispersion by distance is 45 metre. Then I consulted my report and firing tables, I realised I was wrong. What I specified was the value for dispersion by axis. In terms of distance, that dispersion would be 98 metres.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: The correction is hereby on the record. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you again.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let us move onto G-14, which is page 104 in the B/C/S and 115 in the English. The incident took place on the 16th of June, 1995, in Dositejeva 2 [as interpreted] when a modified air bomb hit a -- the UMC building. In line 21, page 72, it was stated that we were going to look into case G-1, whereas we are interested in case G-14?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And did you say Dositejeva 2 or...

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: 4a, I think.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: That should be the correct one.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let me ask you this: Do you know what was located in Dositejeva Street close to the number referred to?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In Dositejeva Street close to the number specified was the command of the 1st Corps of the ABiH, as well as the command of the 105th Mountain Brigade of the ABiH, and only 80 metres away was the Presidency of BiH. You can find it in footnote 286, 287, and 288.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Next I'd like to have a look at 1D00747. We see a report of the Sarajevo-Romanija Corps Command from February 1995. The consolidate unclear. We don't know if it's the 25th or the 5th of February. In the document -- we need page 9 in English and 8 in B/C/S. In the B/C/S it's towards the bottom of the page in the red frame. In the English, we see it towards the top, beginning with the words "Sarajevo squadron." It reads: "Sarajevo Squadron, squad comprising eight pilots from the former JNA located in Dositejeva Street, number 2. Six of the pilots flew the Gazela, one an Mi-8, and one a Jastreb." How far is Dositejeva number 2 from Dositejeva Street number 4A?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As far as I know there is a just a passage between the two buildings.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We would offer this one into evidence, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honours, the B/C/S copy is quite poor and I'm not sure it's complete. Does counsel have an ERN, which I cannot locate on this document, so I could check our records to see if we have a better copy; or alternatively, could he inform us where this copy comes from?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We will check it and I'll inform my colleague.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: And until that information is provided, if we could just hold off on even marking it at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Well, Madam Registrar, the number would be?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: D1273, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And is marked for identification.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Next document I would like to see on our screens is 1D00748.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is a letter sent by the President of the Presidency, Alija Izetbegovic, to the Prime Minister, Haris Silajdzic. In the third paragraph from the bottom, we see the following: "There is another problem. The Chetniks fire at the Presidency building and constantly state that they are doing it because it houses the defence ministry. They know this. It does not matter what the Chetniks say, but UNPROFOR also tells us this. For them, this is a military facility. In addition, the building is entered in the register of cultural monuments and such buildings, pursuant to The Hague Convention and our laws, must not house any potential military targets. Therefore, the Ministry of National Defence should be relocated, first of all, when the moving out starts. "There are supposedly two more buildings in the city owned by the republic which, for unknown reasons, have not been taken over. One is in Dositejeva Street (20 offices) and the other in Kersovanija Street (40 offices). They might help you in resolving this problem." Did you analyse this document?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we took note of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Dositejeva Street is mentioned?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Twenty offices?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Do you know whether it is one of the addresses we have mentioned before, Dositejeva 2 or 4a?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As far as I can see, it is not. They --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: Could the witness kindly repeat the last sentence.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And I would say it is some 80 metres away from the place of incident.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We would offer this one into evidence, Your Honour, as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: No objection.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document 1D00748 receives Exhibit Number D1274, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. [Interpretation] Next I would like to move to incident G-17 which is not in the indictment but the Prosecution tendered P752 and P757 related to it. In the English version, it is page 131; in the Serbian, it is 118.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Why did you have to study this case too; is it related to another case?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I apologise, did you say G-15? I was a bit confused. It's fine now. I know that G-15 was not related to any other event. It seemed I turned the next page. G-17 is something I mentioned today when we discussed Safeta Hadzica 52 where an air bomb fell having had a ricocheted off the TV building. When we studied the incident where an air bomb fell on the TV building, we concluded, based on all the documents at our disposal that this incident is directly related to the air bomb which fell in Safeta Hadzica Street at number 52. There was ricocheted off the studio C roof on the TV building. That is why we had to study this incident in detail in order to clarify the sequence of events and how the projectile reached Safeta Hadzica 52 after the ricochet because, ultimately, it fell in a civilian area.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: In your report, did you come to any conclusion as to whether in the TV building there was a command post?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we provide that in our analysis. Let me tell you where it is. Page 136, figure 72, referenced in footnote 403. That is where the command of the 1st Corps of the ABiH was. It was marked during a testimony as can be seen on the map provided in our report under number 3, depicting the TV building.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We can find in the transcript that the command of the 1st Corps of ABiH was there. Was it the command of the 1st Corps?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of the 1st Corps and a brigade of the 1st Corps of the ABiH.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can we next have 1D5710.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We have no English version, Madam Registrar tells me.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: It's just a map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: It's just a map.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: At the top, it reads: Command posts of the command of the 1st Corps and of the brigades of the 1st Corps of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina in 1993, signed by Commander Vahid Karavelic. Did you rely on this map?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Part of that map is shown on page 136, figure 72.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: In English version, that figure 72 is on the page 150. And we would offer this map into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: No objection to the admission of the map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document 1D05710 receives exhibit number D1275, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: The bomb which exploded at studio C in the TV building, are there any photographs in existence concerning that incident?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, of course -- no, no. There are some photographs that we used, whereas other photographs were not taken. There is no photograph in the photo file that would show the interior of studio C. So there are some photographs but none of them show the interior.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Is there any information about a command post in studio C?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It housed the command - please bear with me - of the 1st Corps of the ABiH. As far as I recall.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: In the documents you studied, did you find any confirmation of your findings, or did you confirm someone else's? Actually, let me ask you who Andrew Knowles is?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, he was a witness. He testified to the incoming trajectory of the projectile. Based on his testimony and that of Per Anton Brennskrag, we were able to confirm the incoming trajectory which is completely different from the one determined by CSB investigators who analysed the traces on the roof of studio C, determining the trajectory in that way. We managed to show that what was in question were two completely different bombs which fell a month apart. Thanks to his testimony -- actually, both testimonies, we were able to determine the incoming trajectory and to use all of the photographs with the traces which existed in the photo file to reach a conclusion.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Next I'd like to move to the Cetinjska incident dated the 28th of June, 1995. It is now called Geteova Street --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: Could Mr. Lukic kindly repeat the page numbers.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Could you please repeat the page number, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is 147 in the B/C/S and 163 in the English. In terms of this incident, the Prosecution tendered P4622, the entire investigation file.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Let me ask you this: What was found or determined?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: What was found by them or by us?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: By you.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We established, based on the traces left on the building which was hit at the level of its ninth floor by a modified air bomb, we determined that the projectile came along the north-south axis, or very close to it. The impact occurred at great height and that it was probably by mistake because the fact -- wire factory is on the same axis. We know that it had been targeted before and that it was used for military-purpose production. Unfortunately, there were civilian casualties by accident because the high-rise is at an altitude of 50 metres above sea level --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: It is some 50 metres taller than the wire factory.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We also concluded that it was technically very likely that the projectile hit the high-rise by chance as can be seen in the documents. In detail B, the axis is marked with a 2, and it corresponds exactly to the direction in which we find the wire factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: What was the situation in the battle theatre at the time?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think there was an all-out offensive at the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Whose offensive?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: There were attempts made to break through the siege of Sarajevo, attempted by the ABiH.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: May I ask the witness what is the basis of this knowledge?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The basis of my knowledge are reports from different places which happened simultaneously; reports on incidents, that is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: About the battles, the all-out offensive, the attempt to break through the siege of Sarajevo? All that is to be found in the reports you studied; correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. It can be found in such reports, as well as UNPROFOR reports.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Have you specified these reports in your -- could you refer to any footnote where you have specified the reports on which you drew these conclusions?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I could review it and tell you later, but whenever we referred to a report, it is mentioned in the report.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's fine. If you could find for us exactly the references for what you just told us, where it is found in the report and to what documents you referred. Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Let us focus on the incident that took place on the 22nd of June, 1995 in Cetinjska Street, number 12. It is page 163 in the B/C/S and 180 in the English. It is in Geteova Street, as it is called nowadays. P993 is the photo file related to the case, as well as P992. Can we have figure 97 on our screens, please. In B/C/S, it is 164; in English, it is 182, the page. What is characteristic in this case?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Investigators determines it was a projectile of 155 millimetres with one rocket engine, and they determined the direction as 270 degrees; whereas, in the official report it is stated that it was fired from Energoinvest factory. Let me note straight away that this direction corresponds to the azimuth of 250, according to the official report. As you can see, there is a sketch of the scene, not quite clear.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Which number?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The sketch is 229.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: 299; correction.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I cannot make it out, but the direction of descent is marked with number 5, whereas direction north is visibly marked. It is a bit clearer in this picture in the sketch. The question arose why would someone who had both 155-millimetre projectiles and Howitzers of the same calibre set up and modify a projectile like this in order to fire it. We made our analyses, and the outcome was considerably different in the end, as you can see in figure 102. We determined in colour blue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic, this is a little bit problematic to follow. You don't have the sketch and the figures before us.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I'm also I'm looking at the clock.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Figure 101 where we can probably better follow --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: But we have 97 on our screens at this moment. It is approximately time to adjourn anyhow. So if you could take us tomorrow with the witness through the relevant portions. Now, Mr. Lukic, even thinking in terms of ten hours, you're very close to that. So would you wind up tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, I'm aware. And I'll check with Madam Registrar to know exactly.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. You're over nine and a half hours. Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: I have just one quick matter since it just happened on the record. I just want it to be clear that -- my non-objection to Exhibit D1275 was not to be understood that I was acknowledging that it was the same as figure 72 in the report, so I see that could be unclear and I just wanted to put that on the record.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. That's hereby clarified. I would have one matter which I'd like to raise, rather, today because we'll adjourn and you have some time until tomorrow. Witness, here and there, reference is made to firing tables of modified aircraft bombs. Are you aware of any -- or do you have copies of any existing modified air bombs firing tables which existed at the time when those modified air bombs were launched? Do you have them? Do you have references to -- again, not to tables which were produced later but tables in existence at the time of firing of those modified air bombs?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have firing tables from 2001, and the only thing I can say --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Witness, I was, of course, asking about not 2001 but in the early 1990s. So the answer is you don't have them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And -- yes. Okay. Then that answers my question. Then I don't have to ask to you try to find them. Do you know, even if you don't have them, whether they existed at the time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I know, they did.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: They did. And you were not able to retrieve them or to ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I said I don't have them now. And now they don't exist.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Did you ever have firing tables in your hands or on paper, firing tables that existed during the armed conflict, that is, between -- for these purposes before -- before December 1995, and is there any way you could retrieve them and present them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I had them in my hands. I saw them. But I have absolutely no way to show them to you now or to retrieve them.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. And who showed them to you?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I saw those tables in -- when those projectiles were tested in Nikinci.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And when was that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Before they started being used.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: But -- yes. But when was that? Was that in 1990, 1995, 2000? When was it?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm sorry, I really don't remember. No, certainly not in 2000. Before they started being used in the war, verifications and testings were made, and on that occasion, I saw the tables.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And my question was who showed them to you?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't remember anymore, but now I think it's one of the engineers from Pretis, one of those who worked on it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Just one clarification. You said, ma'am, that those tables did exist at the time but they no longer exist. What happened to them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I didn't say they didn't exist. I said I could not get hold of that material anymore. Maybe they do exist; maybe they don't.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Maybe you were misinterpreted but I thought I heard you say so.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. We can perhaps --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: One final question from my side. You said you saw them "before they started being used in the war. Verifications and testing were made, and on that occasion, I saw the tables." Were you present when this testing was made and carried out?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Then please explain --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No. Colleagues make to my office and, on that occasion, I saw them.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Were the colleagues present during this testing?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Those are colleagues from the Pretis factory. That's what I meant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Can you give us the names?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Hmm ... I think one of them was colleague Krstic. I can't remember the first name.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Was he in your office or was it in his office?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, he came to me office.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Do you know the time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, I really can't remember. It was around the time before they started being used. Before the testing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Before the testing you saw them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: But, again, when did they start to use them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As far as I can see, it was 2005 -- no, no, sorry, 1995. All these incidents that we have been discussing were involving air bombs and obviously it was according to those tables that they were used. I can only infer that based on the high precision that was achieved in the incidents that we analysed. You know, rocket artillery is, generally speaking, not a precise weapon compared to mortars, for instance, but in the incidents that we discussed, a high precision was achieved which without firing tables is impossible.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This was not my question. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I think we are -- We can see -- Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honours, it did come up just in your examination that she had tables from 2001. Could we please have those by tomorrow, if possible, or before the end of tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Well, do you have the tables that were produced later in 2001 and could you provide them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't have them with me. I didn't bring them. But you could get them through my institute if a request were to be made to the government. I don't think that would be a problem. You know, I don't work there anymore. I could not ask them to give it to me personally now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. That's hereby on the record, Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: I would like to go back to my question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. I must apologise, first of all, to interpreters where I tried just to establish whether or not the witness could bring us anything tomorrow, that we now have gone over the time for ten minutes --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: I understand that. But I would like to go back to my earlier question. Ma'am, at page 83, starting at line 13, Judge Orie asked you: "Do you know, even if you don't have them, whether they existed at the time?" Your answer was: "Yes, I know they did." Next question: Did -- "they did. And you were not able to retrieve them or to -- "A. I said I don't have them now. And now they don't exist." That's what you said. I'm asking you: What happened to them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Maybe I expressed myself explicitly. Maybe they do exist.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: [Overlapping speakers] ... then you must be clear what you said, and that's what you explicitly said: Now they don't exist. That's explicit. Unless --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Could I -- one at a time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: I was saying to you, yes, you expressed yourself explicitly that they do not exist now. That is an explicit answer. I'm saying what happened to them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] From what I know, they don't exist because I never saw them again, and there are some that go together with the system made in 2001.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Unfortunately, that's not an answer to my question. My question was: What happened to them now that you know they don't exist.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The tables were never my work product or my property or the property of the institute, so I can't follow what happened to them.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... again that doesn't answer my question. My question simply is what happened to them. You know they do not exist. What happened to them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is my conviction they don't exist for the reason that I never saw them again. After the war, new ones were developed, and when something new is developed, then the old ones are not used anymore.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: So you are changing your evidence. You don't know for a fact that they don't exist. You conclude they don't exist. You assume they don't exist. Is that your evidence now?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Right, right, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then with apologies to all those assisting us, Witness, we have a late conclusion today. We'd like to see you back tomorrow morning, 9.30. That's on the 30th of September in this same courtroom. I give you the same instruction ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, that's the 1st of October. Same instructions as I gave earlier; that is, not to communicate in whatever way, with whomever about your testimony. You may now follow the usher.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We adjourn for the day, and we'll resume tomorrow, 1st of October, 2015, 9.30 in the morning, in this same courtroom, I.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 1st day of October, 2015, at 9.30 a.m. 22 23 24 25
